info.excerpt: Steer a snake by tilting the board. Runs on the reTerminal Sticky e-paper: 4-second hold-to-calibrate, live tilt ball, tap-to-rezero, high score persists. 倾斜机身控制贪吃蛇：4 秒持机校准、实时倾斜球、点按归零、最高分掉电保存。

blocks.content: GYRO SNAKE is a snake game you steer by tilting the board. It runs entirely on the reTerminal Sticky: the 480x800 e-paper shows the board, the built-in IMU reads your tilt, and the buzzer plays the sounds. The high score is saved on the device.
GYRO SNAKE 是一个靠倾斜机身来控制方向的贪吃蛇游戏，完整运行在 reTerminal Sticky 上：480×800 电子墨水屏显示棋盘，内置 IMU 读取倾斜，蜂鸣器播放音效，最高分保存在设备上。

The live tilt ball in the bottom-right corner shows your current tilt against an 8-degree deadzone, and the heavy tick marks the direction the game currently steers. Tilting within plus/minus 45 degrees of any side turns the snake - diagonals follow the dominant side, and you never need to re-center between turns.
右下角的实时倾斜球显示当前倾斜（内圈为 8° 死区），粗刻度指向当前判定方向。与任意方向偏差 ±45° 以内即判定为该方向，斜倾取主方向，转向之间无需回中。

blocks.title: Flash the firmware 刷入固件
blocks.content: Flash the firmware 刷入固件
Connect the reTerminal Sticky over USB-C and click Flash below. The image is the full flash (bootloader, partition table and game), so the board reboots straight into the title screen.
用 USB-C 连接 reTerminal Sticky，点击下方 Flash。镜像为完整刷写（bootloader + 分区表 + 游戏），完成后自动重启进入标题界面。

blocks.title: Calibrate and steer 校准并开始
blocks.content: Calibrate and steer 校准并开始

Hold the board the way you want to play and tap the screen (or press the AI/OK key). Every start runs a 4-second calibration - keep still during KEEP YOUR PLAY POSE - then you get a 3-second ready window before the snake moves. Tilt the board to steer; eat apples to grow; walls and your own tail end the run.
按你想玩的握姿持机，点击屏幕（或按 AI/OK 键）开始。每次开局有 4 秒校准（KEEP YOUR PLAY POSE 期间保持静止），随后 3 秒准备期蛇不动，可以先预倾方向。倾斜机身控制方向；吃苹果变长；撞墙或撞到自己结束。

Changed your grip mid-game? Tap the tilt ball in the bottom-right corner (or press the DOWN side key) to make the current pose the new zero point. Tap the screen or press OK to pause and resume; press UP while paused to recalibrate from scratch.
中途换了握姿？点击右下角倾斜球（或按 DOWN 键）把当前姿态设为新零点。点屏幕或按 OK 暂停/继续；暂停时按 UP 重新校准。
